description: Election Commission -  Elected Mr. W.M.M.N. Rathnayake as a member of the is Bamunawela of Kurunegala P.S.
categorisation: The gazette content is specifically about filling a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a resignation and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new elected member. This falls squarely under electoral processes at the local government level, making it an **Elections Gazette**.
